services.name: Yacht Search
services.desc: Attending the annual Barcelona MYBA yacht charter shows, I have had the opportunity to check out the distinctively different four Balearic Islands: Mallorca, Menorca, Ibiza, and Formentera. The quiet one is Menorca with the Mahon Harbor attracting sail and motor yachts. It is much more laid-back and, in my opinion, the most authentic island with a diverse population. Ibiza in May is delightful and it’s easy to walk around the town center. However, when July and August come, the crowds come to party. While in Ibiza, I took a quick ferry ride to Formentera. services.name: Incentive Programs
services.desc: have many forms. Your people work hard to make your business a success. With a corporate incentive program, you can reward them and let them recharge in a way they’ll never forget: on a private yacht charter getaway. The rhythm of the sea and the ocean breeze can renew spirits almost instantly. Show your key people how much you value their contribution when you send them on a luxury yacht cruise. For large groups, we can arrange a totally private yacht for up to 100 guests, an intimate yacht for up to 28 guests, or, for a more Caribbean sailing experience, entertain a professionally-staffed flotilla of yachts, sailing in tandem. blurb: Carol Kent Yacht Charters International offers personalized planning for luxury yacht charters in destinations worldwide including the Caribbean, Mediterranean, North America, South Pacific, and northern Europe. They provide complimentary services to tailor yacht, crew, and destination to client preferences and assist with ground transportation, private planes, and local experiences.
